column1: # The voice's whole vocabulary. One row per clip.
# id is explicit and MUST NEVER be renumbered: it is the number the
# firmware plays ('A <id>') and the name of the file on the device
# (/v/NN.raw). Adding a clip means appending a new id, never inserting.
# slug is the basename of the TTS wav in voice/wav/, so rendering the set
# is: for each row, speak `text` into voice/wav/{slug}.wav.
# bank + key are what app/experiments/counterpull/voice.js selects on.
# Several rows may share a (bank, key); the director picks among them at
# random so the same situation does not always produce the same sentence.
